history.text: I'm tracking a few things today. We're close to signing a distribution deal with a Japanese retailer, and there's a competing bid from a Korean group that might undercut us. Anything that shifts leverage — tariff news, logistics disruptions in East Asia, currency moves — I want to know fast.
On it. I'll watch for anything that changes your negotiating position. How fast are we talking — interrupt you, or batch it?
If it's something I could act on within the hour, interrupt me. Otherwise just keep a running log and I'll check in between calls.
Got it. Urgent and actionable gets pushed, everything else goes in the log.
Also keep an ear out for anything on Meridian specifically — press mentions, competitor announcements in our space, anyone talking about us. We just closed our Series A so there might be chatter.
Will do. I'll separate deal-relevant signals from brand mentions so you can triage quickly.
Perfect. I'm jumping into back-to-back calls now. If you surface something, keep it to two lines max — what happened and what I should consider doing.
